info.title: ExtremeCloud MSP Workspace API
info.description:
The **ExtremeCloud MSP Workspace API** enables Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to programmatically manage their tenant portfolio, licenses, network devices, users, and more.

## Authentication
All endpoints require a valid **Bearer JWT token**.

### How to obtain an IAM access token

**Option 1 — API Keys (recommended for automation)**
1. Log in to **Extreme Platform ONE**
2. Navigate to **Integrations → API Keys**
3. Generate a new API key — this is your IAM access token

**Option 2 — Browser developer tools (for quick testing)**
1. Log in to **Extreme Platform ONE** in your browser
2. Open the browser **Developer Tools** (F12 or right-click → Inspect)
3. Go to the **Network** tab and look at any authenticated request
4. Copy the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` value from the request headers

Include the token in every request:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your-iam-access-token>
```

## Data Isolation
All data is scoped to the authenticated MSP admin's **home account**. Cross-account access is not permitted.

## Support
For API access or integration questions, contact [support@extremenetworks.com](mailto:support@extremenetworks.com).

post.description: Validates the MSP admin's ExtremeCloud IAM access token and initialises their MSP workspace session. This endpoint must be called once per session before accessing any other MSP API endpoints. The IAM access token must be provided as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

200.description: Login workflow completed successfully — MSP session is active

400.description: Bad request — missing or malformed Authorization header

401.description: Unauthorized — IAM token is invalid, expired, or does not belong to an MSP admin

500.description: Internal server error — MSP session initialisation failed

post.description: Creates a new customer account under the authenticated MSP admin's home account. Admin groups and a license account can be assigned to the customer as part of the creation request. Returns 206 Partial Content when the customer was created but one or more optional assignments (e.g. license, team) failed.

get.description: List all admin groups (user teams) created within the MSP workspace, including group names and member counts.

patch.description: Updates the specified customer account. Supported operations include adding or removing admin group access to the customer, and linking or unlinking a license account. Returns 206 Partial Content when some requested changes succeeded but others failed.

parameters.name: customerOwnerId
parameters.description: Owner ID of the customer account to edit

get.summary: Get linked licenses for the MSP
get.description: Returns the list of Extreme license accounts that have been linked (fully pairing-confirmed) to the authenticated MSP home account. Linked accounts have completed the full OAuth + Internal IT System linking flow and are eligible to be assigned to customers.

get.summary: Get assigned license name of given customer accountIDs
get.description: Look up the softlinked license account name for one or more tenant account IDs. Returns the license name associated with each account via the soft-link relationship.

get.summary: Get License Info for an MSP
get.description:
Returns license customer information for the MSP's linked Extreme license accounts. Results can be filtered by license account name and/or product line:
- `isSdwan=true` — include only SD-WAN license entries
- `isUz=true` — include only UZTNA (Zero Trust Network Access) license entries
- `search` — free-text search applied across all returned fields (account name, status, etc.)
Omit all filters to retrieve the full license picture for the authenticated MSP home account.

Retrieves the list of available Regional Data Centers (RDCs) for creating tenant instances.
Results can be filtered by SD-WAN or ZTNA capability. This endpoint is scoped to the
authenticated MSP admin's home account.

parameters.name: isSdwan
parameters.description: Whether to get list of SD-WAN enabled data centers.

parameters.name: isZtna
parameters.description: Whether to get list of ZTNA-enabled data centers.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of data centers

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token

get.description: Get customer accounts with filter and pagination

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter by Account Id. Special case: when set, this account is always included via an OR match, bypassing the `ids` and `subAttributeIds` filters for this single account.

parameters.name: subAttributeIds
parameters.description: Filter to tenants that have ALL of the given Tenant Tag (sub-attribute) IDs assigned. Does not apply to the account matched by `id`, which is always included regardless of this filter.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

get.summary: Get list of all available customers for MSP admin
get.description: Returns the full list of customer accounts visible to the authenticated MSP admin, optionally filtered by editability. Results are scoped to the MSP admin's home account — customers belonging to other MSPs are not returned.

parameters.name: isEditable
parameters.description: When true, returns only customers that the admin has permission to edit. When false or omitted, returns all visible customers.

400.description: Bad request — invalid or missing query parameters

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token

get.description: Returns aggregated monthly billing usage data for the MSP's license account. Supports filtering by date range (month granularity), tenant account, and license feature group or sub-group. This endpoint is scoped to the authenticated MSP admin's home account. Data from other accounts is not accessible.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Invoice creation date range - From Date(mm/dd/yyyy)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Invoice creation date range - To Date(mm/dd/yyyy)

parameters.name: featureGroup
parameters.description: Filtering by License Feature Group or Subgroup

200.description: Successful operation — returns monthly usage records

400.description: Bad request — missing or invalid query parameters

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token

get.description: Returns day-level billing usage data for the MSP's license account. Supports filtering by date range (day granularity), tenant account, and license feature group or sub-group. delete.description: Marks the specified customer account as inactive (pending deletion). This is a soft-delete operation — the customer record is deactivated rather than permanently removed. Additional steps by the CloudOps team are required to fully remove the underlying customer account. The MSP admin cannot delete their own home account.

parameters.name: customerOwnerId
parameters.description: Owner ID of the customer account to delete

firstName.description: First name of the customer's initial admin user. Required when generateDummyCustomerAdmin is false.

lastName.description: Last name of the customer's initial admin user. Required when generateDummyCustomerAdmin is false.

email.description: Email address for the customer's initial admin user. Must be a valid email format (max 84 chars). Required when generateDummyCustomerAdmin is false.

password.description: Password for the customer's initial admin user. Required when generateDummyCustomerAdmin is false.

datacenter.description: Target datacenter for the customer account. Use the 'name' field value from the GET /datacenters endpoint response.

phone.description: Phone number of the customer's admin contact.

address.description: Street address of the customer organization.

state.description: State or province of the customer organization.

adminGroupIdsToGiveAccess.description: Set of MSP admin group IDs that should be granted access to manage this customer. Obtain valid IDs from the GET /admin-groups endpoint.

licenseAccountName.description: Name of the license account to associate with the customer. Obtain valid names from the GET /license-accounts endpoint.

licenseAccountAllocation.description: License allocation configuration specifying per-feature capacity limits for the customer. Each entry defines a product feature and its maximum allowed quantity.

enableAI.description: Whether to enable AI-powered features (e.g., CoPilot) for this customer account. Defaults to true if not specified.

subAttributeAssignments.description: Sub-attribute ID assignments for categorizing this tenant. Use sub-attribute IDs obtained from the GET /attributes endpoint.

max_number.description: Maximum number of licenses the customer can use for this feature. Unit: license seats.
